preconditions.description: The board dimensions n and m are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in board)
preconditions.description: Each row of the board has exactly m columns.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in '.wb' for row in board for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the board is either '.', 'w', or 'b'.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in return_value[1:])
postconditions.description: Each row of the tiling description has exactly m columns.

postconditions.expression: all(cell in '.abcd' for row in return_value[1:] for cell in row)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the tiling description is either '.', 'a', 'b', 'c', or 'd'.

postconditions.expression: all(cell == '.' or (cell in 'abcd' and all(board[i][j] == board[i][j+1] == board[i][j+2] == 'w' for j in range(m-2) if return_value[i+1][j] == return_value[i+1][j+1] == return_value[i+1][j+2] == cell)) for i in range(n) for j in range(m-2) if return_value[i+1][j] == return_value[i+1][j+1] == return_value[i+1][j+2] != '.')
postconditions.description: Each trimino covers three consecutive white squares horizontally.

postconditions.expression: all(cell == '.' or (cell in 'abcd' and all(board[i][j] == board[i+1][j] == board[i+2][j] == 'w' for i in range(n-2) if return_value[i+1][j] == return_value[i+2][j] == return_value[i+3][j] == cell)) for j in range(m) for i in range(n-2) if return_value[i+1][j] == return_value[i+2][j] == return_value[i+3][j] != '.')
postconditions.description: Each trimino covers three consecutive white squares vertically.

postconditions.expression: all(cell == '.' or (cell in 'abcd' and all(board[i][j] == board[i][j+1] == board[i][j+2] == 'b' for j in range(m-2) if return_value[i+1][j] == return_value[i+1][j+1] == return_value[i+1][j+2] == cell)) for i in range(n) for j in range(m-2) if return_value[i+1][j] == return_value[i+1][j+1] == return_value[i+1][j+2] != '.')
postconditions.description: Each trimino covers three consecutive black squares horizontally.

postconditions.expression: all(cell == '.' or (cell in 'abcd' and all(board[i][j] == board[i+1][j] == board[i+2][j] == 'b' for i in range(n-2) if return_value[i+1][j] == return_value[i+2][j] == return_value[i+3][j] == cell)) for j in range(m) for i in range(n-2) if return_value[i+1][j] == return_value[i+2][j] == return_value[i+3][j] != '.')
postconditions.description: Each trimino covers three consecutive black squares vertically.

postconditions.expression: all(cell == '.' or (cell in 'abcd' and all(return_value[i+1][j] != return_value[i+1][j+1] for j in range(m-1) if return_value[i+1][j] == return_value[i+1][j+1] != '.')) for i in range(n) for j in range(m-1))
postconditions.description: Adjacent cells in the same row with the same trimino symbol are not adjacent in the board.

postconditions.expression: all(cell == '.' or (cell in 'abcd' and all(return_value[i+1][j] != return_value[i+2][j] for i in range(n-1) if return_value[i+1][j] == return_value[i+2][j] != '.')) for j in range(m) for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: Adjacent cells in the same column with the same trimino symbol are not adjacent in the board.
